summary.business_type: SaaS / Online Tool (free image processing utility)
top_findings: Single-page site: 1 URL in sitemap vs. 8+ planned — missing blog and sub-tool pages limits topical authority
3 oversized demo PNGs total 1.1 MB; JPEG equivalents exist at ~95% smaller
Gallery comparison images are JS-generated (Canvas API), invisible to crawlers and AI
Missing trust pages: no privacy policy, terms, about page, or author attribution
theme-color meta tag contains an image URL instead of a hex color code
quick_wins: Swap 3 oversized PNGs for existing JPEGs (1.1 MB savings)
Add width/height attributes to all tags (eliminates CLS)
Add FAQPage structured data matching existing 10 FAQ items
Create and submit image sitemap for 12 static images

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt present with sitemap reference
Canonical URL correctly set
Meta robots index,follow declared
UTF-8 charset, viewport, lang=en all present
SSL via Cloudflare Pages (verify post-deploy)

findings.title: Sitemap contains only 1 URL
findings.description: The sitemap lists only the root URL. The build strategy planned 6+ sub-pages. Current state provides zero content-breadth signal to search engines.
findings.recommendation: Build planned sub-pages (blog, deep-fried-meme-maker, compress-image, pixelate-image) and add them to sitemap.

findings.title: No custom 404 page
findings.description: No 404.html in dist output. Astro's default 404 is minimal.
findings.recommendation: Create /404.html with navigation back to the tool.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: No X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add public/_headers file with security directives for Cloudflare Pages.

categories.name: Content Quality (E-E-A-T)
what_works: ~8,100 words of technically accurate, genuinely helpful content
Covers 5+ distinct use cases in depth
10-item FAQ with substantial answers
How it works section demonstrates real technical expertise
Reference table for best settings is uniquely useful

findings.title: No author or organizational attribution
findings.description: Zero signals about who built the tool. For a site handling ID photos and government form images, this is a trust gap.
findings.recommendation: Add an About page with organizational attribution and contact info.

findings.title: Missing privacy policy and terms pages
findings.description: Tool claims 100% private processing in copy but has no dedicated privacy policy page to back it up.
findings.recommendation: Create /privacy/ and /terms/ pages. Even for client-side-only tools, a privacy policy is a trust signal.

findings.title: No external citations or authoritative outbound links
findings.description: Guide sections reference Reddit communities, JPEG standards, and historical context but never link out.
findings.recommendation: Add outbound links to authoritative sources (Reddit, Wikipedia, technical references).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tag: 69 characters — excellent length, keyword-rich
H1: exact match for 'Low Quality Image Maker'
14 H2 headings with clean hierarchy
8 Open Graph tags and 4 Twitter Card tags fully configured
og:image verified at 1200×630

findings.title: theme-color meta tag is an image URL, not a color
findings.description: Content attribute is https://low-quality-image-maker.com/og-image.png instead of a hex color.
findings.recommendation: Change to #18181b or the brand accent color.

findings.title: Meta description exceeds 160-character SERP limit
findings.description: At 168 characters, the last 8-13 characters will be truncated in search results.
findings.recommendation: Trim to 155-160 characters by removing a lower-priority feature mention.

findings.title: All internal links are in-page anchors
findings.description: 11 internal links all point to # sections. No cross-page linking because sub-pages don't exist yet.
findings.recommendation: Add cross-page internal linking when sub-pages are built.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: WebApplication schema with feature list, $0 price, OS support
Organization schema with name and URL
HowTo schema with 3 properly structured steps
FAQPage schema detected in HTML

findings.title: FAQPage schema available but should be validated
findings.description: With 10 well-structured FAQ items using <details> elements, the FAQPage schema could generate rich results.
findings.recommendation: Validate with Google Rich Results Test and ensure mainEntity array is complete.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList and SiteNavigationElement
findings.description: Low priority for single-page site; add when sub-pages are created.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema on sub-pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CSS inlined in <head> — no render-blocking external stylesheets
JS modules deferred (type=module) — non-blocking
Demo images use loading=lazy
System font stack — no font downloads
Zero third-party scripts, analytics, or trackers

findings.title: Total page weight ~1.35 MB — images are 87%
findings.description: HTML (114 KB) + CSS (26 KB) + JS (38 KB) + Images (1,203 KB) = ~1,381 KB. Images dominate the payload.
findings.recommendation: Swap oversized PNGs for JPEGs. Add WebP variants. Add image dimensions to prevent CLS.

findings.title: 3 oversized PNG demo files: 1.1 MB wasted
findings.description: meme-deepfried-degraded.png (409 KB), gradient-vintage-degraded.png (403 KB), photo-crt-degraded.png (292 KB). JPEG equivalents exist at 21, 16, 14 KB.
findings.recommendation: Replace with JPEG versions. PNG is wrong format for artifact-heavy, degraded images.

findings.title: No image dimensions — guaranteed CLS
findings.description: All 10 img tags lack width/height attributes, causing layout shift as images load.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes matching actual image dimensions.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 10 img tags have descriptive alt text
OG image matches declared dimensions (1200x630)
Favicon is SVG (301 bytes — ideal)
Demo images are consistent 400x400

findings.title: Gallery comparison images are JS-generated, invisible to crawlers
findings.description: The 'See the degradation in action' section renders via Canvas API. Crawlers see only 'Loading comparison gallery...' placeholder.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render comparison images as static img tags in the HTML template.

findings.title: PNG used where JPEG belongs
findings.description: Three degraded demo images are PNG despite being artifact-heavy visuals. JPEG equivalents exist at ~95% smaller.
findings.recommendation: Swap to JPEG for all degraded output demos. Reserve PNG for pixel art and transparency needs.

findings.title: No responsive images or WebP variants
findings.description: All demo images are 400x400 with no srcset. No WebP copies exist.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with 200w and 400w variants. Create WebP copies for all demo images.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Content is well-structured with 14 H2 headings
FAQ uses semantic <details> elements
Meta description is accurate
All content is in initial HTML (no client-side rendering)

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: An llms.txt file would help LLM crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) understand and cite the tool.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with tool description and links to key pages.

findings.title: Zero brand citation signals
findings.description: New domain with no backlinks or mentions. LLMs have no basis for citing this tool.
findings.recommendation: List on Product Hunt, AlternativeTo, and other tool directories to build initial backlinks.

findings.title: Gallery content invisible to AI crawlers
findings.description: Same as image search — Canvas-rendered comparison pairs are not crawlable by AI systems.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render comparison images as static content.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix theme-color meta tag (change image URL to #18181b)
Replace 3 oversized PNGs with existing JPEGs (1.1 MB savings)
Pre-render gallery comparison images as static HTML img tags
Add width/height attributes to all img tags
Create privacy policy page (/privacy/)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Build 3 sub-tool pages (deep-fried-meme-maker, compress-image, pixelate-image)
Launch blog with 3 seed posts
Add WebP versions of all demo images with srcset
Create About page with organizational attribution
Validate and enhance FAQPage structured data

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Create image sitemap for 12 static images
Add 2 more blog posts (aesthetic history, competitor comparison)
Create llms.txt at root
Submit to tool directories (Product Hunt, AlternativeTo)
Add outbound authority links throughout guides
Add security headers via _headers file

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages, submit sitemap to GSC
Set up GA4 + GSC monitoring
Monitor Core Web Vitals via CrUX
Expand sub-pages for long-tail keywords
Build custom 404 page
